about_the_game:
• Get In Timelessness — is a psychological horror game about hidden nightmares that can only be seen by accident. The story that unfolds here tells about a man and his fate to face the unthinkable, to go through horror, to sink to the very bottom of the impossible.


  • The main character of this story is Calib, a twenty—five-year-old guy from Tennessee, an office worker and an exemplary husband... But all this was crossed out by one tragic event: his wife, Ellie, died in a car accident.

    Unable to cope with the pain of loss, Calib tried to find salvation in alcoholic oblivion. So began his aimless wanderings through the bars of the city, hoping to numb the pain a little and learn to live with it.
    And this path led him to the doors of the "Star Light" bar.

  • Is Calib story defined by one outcome, or does it have other endings?

  • Features:

The main character of the game is not a hero or a villain. This is an ordinary man whose life has gone downhill. Trying to make sense of his loss, he is faced with something that goes beyond the norm;

Explore 2D locations and uncover alternate endings by interacting with the world in different ways — you may find that Calib's story doesn’t always end the same way;

The game's story is based on the author's original universe and the short story "Get in Timelessness." This is the first step towards other stories that are waiting in the wings on the other side of the ink.

content_descriptors.notes:
There is no sexual content in the game at all (no BDSM, no hints, nothing). Except that a light flirtation with the barmaid can be considered similar content.

The game has a depressing, gloomy atmosphere at some points.

There is cruelty shown to the main character and scenes with his deaths (there will be a little more such deaths in the future).

Drug use is also mentioned, but it is not idealized. There is no obvious inclination to such a thing, the position of the the main character is sharply the opposite of this.

The topic of alcohol is often raised, and smoking is rarely mentioned. Towards the end of the game, the main character is less willing to deal with alcoholic beverages.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 1.8 GHz or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with Windows
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.4 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible with Windows
  • Additional Notes: For the best experience, install on SSD.

short_description: A psychological horror about a man who, by the will of fate — or a joke of chance — had to face the unthinkable. Sometimes a person looks into the abyss. Sometimes the abyss looks at you. And sometimes... She turns out to be Hungry.
